follow-up time: Up to 9 years (duration of participation in surveillance network)
exposure: length of participation in SSI surveillance networks
Participation in surgical site infection (SSI) surveillance network
Surgical procedure (cardiovascular, digestive, gynaecological-obstetrical, neurosurgical, and orthopaedic)
cohort: Data from 17 surgical site infection surveillance networks in 15 high-income countries, including 5,831,737 operations
finding: Participation in an SSI surveillance network was associated with a significant decrease in SSI rates over time, with a 35% reduction observed by the ninth year of participation.
mod_finding: Cesarean section SSI rates showed a strong consistent decrease over time.
country: 15 high-income countries across Asia, Australia and Europe
